Desert air / endless sky

An invitation to wander

Out here,
time gets softer.

Some places ask you to do less. To trade the familiar hum for the sound of the wind, and a ceiling for a sky full of possibility.

Salt & Stars is a fictional camp imagined for the curious: part fireside gathering, part open-air observatory, entirely unhurried.
